interventions: The parent supplied paths to the installed public API reference and standard-library interfaces after the installed README omitted native function signatures; no repository implementation or other builder results were inspected.
failures: The first contract-helper write to its default ~/.liminate/contracts path was blocked by workspace write permissions; it was reopened under the private workdir's contracts directory.
Creating a scaffold at the already populated workdir root was rejected; the native scaffold was created in a subdirectory.
Initial guessed SQLite function names were unresolved; the installed interface files resolved the API before application implementation continued.
One transient installed-binary path typo returned file-not-found and was corrected before compilation or acceptance runs.

recommendation.reason: For this local catalog on the installed Veritas host, the native SQLite/TOML services produced a Python-free app package that installed and ran with an external caller-selected data root. The result is task-specific; no Python comparison was built.
recommendation.observed_user_benefit: Separate process runs preserved book state, rejected operations left prior state intact, invalid dates were rejected before database access, and a project copy with spaces and Unicode used a separate data directory.
material_regressions: The installed README did not include service signatures, so shipped API reference and interface files were needed after initial API guesses failed.
The typed source is 10,202 bytes for this small catalog; the compiled artifact is 45,002 bytes.
One installed launch took 1.11 seconds on macOS ARM64; this is a single measurement.
No paired Python builder or cross-host run was performed.

limitations: The due-soon follow-up was implemented in the first source pass, so followup_seconds is 0.0 incremental post-baseline coding time; the follow-up behavior was exercised independently in the acceptance run.
setup_seconds is measured from contract opening to the first successful native check and includes API discovery and first implementation, rather than environment setup alone.
Performance and package-size measurements cover only this macOS ARM64 host; no paired Python implementation was measured.
